summary.note: Full aspect comparison skipped because eval-result.json and full per-case artifacts are absent after eval abort. This report records only the case-specific execution gap evidenced by eval-stream.log, trace_step, sql_audit, current compiled-plan behavior, and source diff against HEAD.

gaps.detail: Round 6 FIX-D budget sizing worked far enough to pass the previous 50-query boundary; Round 7 reached the later interaction/channel fetch at query_count=52 under max_query=70. The abort is a tool evidence-alias contract bug: HEAD fetch_related_signal appends the selected element token to an explicit lane alias, so E3_ch_interaction becomes E3_ch_interaction_paid_ads. With the eval run id, that evidence_id is 65 characters and violates evidence.evidence_id varchar(64), producing SYSTEM_TABLE_WRITE_FAILED after two guarded SQL queries. A rollback-only insert test showed the intended unsuffixed E3_ch_interaction evidence would fit and persist, so this is not a budget failure, not a SQL guard failure, and not ranking.
